profiles.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (4x Cortex-A72 @ 1.5 GHz, CPU only)
profiles.hardware_name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (4x Cortex-A72 @ 1.5 GHz, CPU only)
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: effective sustained PyTorch FP32 throughput of 3.0 GFLOP/s on 4x Cortex-A72 @ 1.5 GHz (well below the NEON theoretical peak; framework, memory bandwidth and thermal throttling dominate).
ASSUMPTION: 25 ms fixed per-frame overhead (image decode, resize, Python and NMS).
Model: latency_ms = GFLOPs_at_imgsz / effective_GFLOPs * 1000 + overhead_ms; GFLOPs scale with (imgsz/ref)^2.
No accelerator (Coral / Hailo) assumed. Batch size 1. Active cooling assumed.
ESTIMATE ONLY - never measured. Replace with a measurement on the actual device.
